title: Jolly Smoky Ukrainian Rice Pilaf
description: A malty, springy, kid-friendly Ukrainian dish featuring rice, smoke, and low-calorie ingredients, served in an earthenware bowl.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent.
Add the grated carrots and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large earthenware bowl, combine the cooked onions and carrots, crushed Rice Krispies, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the chicken broth and malt syrup.
Pour the broth mixture over the Rice Krispies mixture and stir until everything is well combined.
Cover the bowl with a lid and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is lightly toasted.
